summary: Grayscale Dogecoin Trust ETF filed an 8-K reporting amendments to Authorized Participant Agreements with Macquarie Capital (USA) Inc. and Virtu Americas LLC, enabling in-kind creations and redemptions alongside the existing cash-based process, and a Sixth Amendment adding Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. as an additional custodian. No securities, stake, price, premium, or transaction terms are involved; this is an operational/structural update to the Trust's creation-redemption mechanics and custody arrangements under its effective S-1, not a special situation. Watch for AP onboarding, liquidity, and tracking implications.
